summary: Opened quotation S00021 (id=21, customer fwod84-n1 Bench Customer) in Odoo Sales and added a second order line via the product dropdown, choosing "[FURN_7777] Office Chair" (different from the existing Acoustic Bloc Screens line), quantity 2. After saving, the order lines read: line 1 Acoustic Bloc Screens qty 3.00 @ £295.00 = £885.00; line 2 Office Chair qty 2.00 @ £70.00 = £140.00, both taxed 20%. The totals block on the saved form now shows Untaxed Amount £1,025.00, Tax 20% £205.00, Total £1,230.00.
